user.title: Add a Synergy meter
user.description: Name the meter. After setup, use **Configure** on the integration to upload Interval Data Files.

error.invalid_name: The name must contain at least one letter or digit.

abort.already_configured: A meter with this name is already configured.

upload.title: Upload Interval Data File
upload.description: Choose the CSV downloaded from Synergy. Uploads can be repeated; the newest upload wins for any 30-minute reading it contains.

delete.title: Delete all data
delete.description: This permanently deletes every stored reading and every statistic of this meter. Submit to confirm.

error.invalid_file: The file was rejected and nothing was stored. {error}
